headline: Egypt Parliament Authorizes Military Support to Defend Saudi Arabia Amid Houthi Threats
summary: Egypt's parliament authorized military support to defend Saudi Arabia on the same day Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on pumping stations along the kingdom's pipeline.
why: Geopolitical tensions and security threats in the Middle East directly impact crude oil logistics, regional stability, and energy market pricing.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Attacks and threats on regional oil infrastructure raise supply disruption concerns.

why_moved: Escalating geopolitical conflict and threats to Middle Eastern energy infrastructure heighten supply anxiety among commodity traders.
